subject: biology

hotspots.label: Leaf blade
hotspots.description: The broad, flat green part of the leaf that is the main food-making surface.
hotspots.positionHint: The wide green body of the leaf.
hotspots.function: Catches light and carry out photosynthesis.

hotspots.label: Vein
hotspots.description: A network of tiny tubes running through the leaf that bring water in and carry food out.
hotspots.positionHint: A branching line running across the leaf blade.
hotspots.function: Carries water in and food out.

hotspots.label: Chlorophyll
hotspots.description: The green pigment inside the leaf cells that captures energy from sunlight.
hotspots.positionHint: A small green dot-cell highlighted inside the cut interior.

hotspots.label: Stomata pore
hotspots.description: A tiny pore on the leaf surface that lets carbon dioxide in and oxygen out during photosynthesis.
hotspots.positionHint: Small open pore dot on the leaf surface, surface layer toggled on.
hotspots.function: Lets carbon dioxide in and oxygen out.

visualStyleNotes: Anatomy Atelier bar throughout: warm off-white/paper background (#F7F3EC) with a soft radial vignette, no vault, no floor grid, no scene props. A clean stylized diorama - a single broad green leaf, muted greens on cream paper, not cartoon, not cluttered, no glow. Strong saturated color reserved for the flat hotspot dots.
materialNotes: Metallic-roughness PBR, metallic=0, matte roughness ~0.5-0.65. Semi-transparent interior is a special alpha, not emissive.
assetBrief: SUBJECT: a single broad, flat green leaf on a short stalk, clean and stylized. A cutaway reveals the spongy interior with green chloroplasts and a branching network of veins. Small pore dots (stomata) on the surface. Muted green on warm cream. Named nodes: LeafBlade, Stalk, VascularVein, ChloroplastCell, StomataPores. Budget 10-14k.
